notes.title: CottontailVA Joins VTumbler!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2744110/VTumbler/][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44790642/d5dff79f191cc78e115e9cfb56f4aff31d3f21ca.png[/img][/url]

We're delighted to announce the fifth VTuber to join the [i]VTumbler [/i]roster is the talented voice actor and VTuber, CottontailVA!

She'll be available for free alongside FeFe, Chibidoki, Fream, and obkatiekat in the base game at launch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2744110/VTumbler/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2744110/VTumbler/][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44790642/fc47063f9519f4b3fecf8ec5e818711a8d86ae18.png[/img][/url]

We're excited to announce that the [i]VTumbler [/i]demo is now live and ready to play! Plus, [i]VTumbler [/i]is being showcased in the Steam Next Fest!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2744110/VTumbler/

[previewyoutube=E8swbZ9HDTg;full][/previewyoutube]
In addition to the demo, we’ve launched a Kickstarter for VTumbler, including amazing rewards! [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/196171533/vtumbler?ref=3ii9z1]Click here to check it out and consider supporting it![/url]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/196171533/vtumbler?ref=3ii9z1][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44790642/21d58716369a8f66af6a51513997c362c252d72c.png[/img][/url]

Don't forget to check out the brand new website for [i]VTumbler[/i] that recently opened to the public and can be viewed [url=https://vtumbler.com/]here[/url].
